question:
Choose the correct word to complete the sentence:

It was one of the most ________ incidents in aviation history during the Pacific War.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"bewildering"** means something that causes confusion or perplexity; it is often used to describe situations or events that are difficult to understand. (चकरा देने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **The instructions for assembling the furniture were so **bewildering** that I had to call for help.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"bewildering"** refers to something that is extremely confusing or hard to understand. (चकरा देने वाला)
 
 
• **Example: **It was one of the most **bewildering** incidents in aviation history during the Pacific War.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **bewildering**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Colluding **(सांठ-गांठ करना): To act together secretly or illegally in order to deceive or cheat someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The companies were found colluding to fix prices.
 
 
 
• **Archaic **(प्राचीन): Very old or old-fashioned.
 
 
• **Example: **The museum houses many archaic artifacts.
 
 
 
• **Mundane** (सामान्य): Lacking interest or excitement; dull.
 
 
• **Example:** She completed the mundane task of cleaning the house.
 
 

34:Tc20,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
